name: vscode server

check.cmd: hash code-server > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo installed || echo uninstall

install: curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/coder/code-server/releases | awk 'match($0,/.*"html_url": "(.*\/releases\/tag\/.*)".*/)' | head -n 1 | awk -F '"' '{print $4}' | awk -F '/v' '{print $2}' | xargs -I {} bash -c 'curl -#fL -o ~/.cache/code-server/code-server_{}_arm64.deb -C - https://github.com/coder/code-server/releases/download/v{}/code-server_{}_arm64.deb' - {}

additional.mac: osascript -e 'tell application "Terminal" to activate' -e 'tell application "Terminal" to do script "ssh -N -L localhost:9888:localhost:9888 $user@$ip"'

description.zh: VS Code Server：可以使用Web版本的VS Code查看、编辑远端的代码。
description.en: VS Code Server is a service you can run on a remote development machine, like your desktop PC or a virtual machine (VM).
